headline: Rackspace shuts down Spot cloud platform after security breach
summary: Rackspace is shutting down its Spot cloud platform after a security breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes clusters and secrets. Customers have until December 8 to migrate workloads, download their data, and rotate compromised credentials before the service closes.
